description: This file defines the 'InstancesSettings' SwiftUI View component, presenting a UI for monitoring and managing connected instances in the application. It includes UI elements like headers, list of instances, and device icons, and handles user interactions such as refresh actions. Additionally, it contains helper functions for icons, platform info, and presence status, with a debug extension providing sample data for testing.

classes.name: InstancesSettings
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View for displaying connected instances and their statuses.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing an Android robot icon.

methods.name: instanceRow

methods.name: label

methods.name: presenceStatus
